name: atriarch-activity
description: Streams Claude Code session, tool-call and subagent activity to an Atriarch Activity hub for live graph visualization.
author: Atriarch Systems

hub_url.title: Activity hub URL
hub_url.description: Base URL of the Atriarch Activity hub, e.g. https://activity.example.com (no trailing slash needed).

api_key.title: Ingest API key
api_key.description: Activity hub API key with the ingest role, sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Activity hub workspace to ingest events into.

include_prompts.title: Include prompt text
include_prompts.description: When enabled, forwards the full text of user prompts to the hub. Off by default: only the prompt's character count is sent.
